authorityRule: Apply after frozen donor ingestion and before any reader/display composition. No correction may create ritual state.
donorPolicy: Frozen donor hashes remain unchanged; this layer records adjudicated source corrections explicitly.

corrections.from: Accept, O Holy father, Almighty and Eternal God, this spotless host, which I, Your unworthy servant, offer to You
corrections.to: Accept, O holy Father, almighty and everlasting God, this spotless host, which I, Thine unworthy servant, offer unto Thee
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), printed p. 23, PDF p. 24
corrections.decision: Align invocation and address with traditional Thou/Thee register; retain substantive remainder of existing translation rather than blindly replacing a full prayer.

corrections.from: May this incense blessed by You, arise before You, O Lord, and may Your mercy come down upon us.
corrections.to: May this incense which Thou hast blessed, O Lord, ascend to Thee, and may Thy mercy descend upon us.
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), printed p. 25, PDF p. 26
corrections.decision: Repair subject-verb comma and restore coherent traditional diction; follow booklet witness.

corrections.from: Let my prayer, O Lord, like incense before You; the lifting up of my hands, like the evening sacrifice.
corrections.to: Let my prayer rise before Thee as incense, O Lord; let the lifting up of my hands be as the evening sacrifice.
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), printed p. 25, PDF p. 26 (poetic translation); Latin Dirigatur oratio mea verified against same booklet PDF p. 25
corrections.decision: Restore missing finite verb and use traditional Thou register; minimal, Latin-faithful editorial adaptation rather than verbatim booklet translation.

corrections.from: May the Lord receive the sacrifice from thy hands, to the praise and glory of His name, to our benefit also, and that of all His holy Church.
corrections.to: May the Lord accept the Sacrifice from thy hands, to the praise and glory of His Name, for our benefit and for that of all His holy Church.
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), printed p. 27, PDF p. 28
corrections.decision: Prefer booklet English for Suscipiat response; preserve whole Latin, speaker/response owner, and separate priest Amen.

corrections.from: offer unto thy excellent majesty of thy gifts and grants,
corrections.to: offer unto Thy most sovereign Majesty out of the gifts Thou hast bestowed upon us,
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 38

corrections.from: Admonished by saving precepts, and formed by divine teaching, we dare to say:
corrections.to: Admonished by Thy saving precepts and formed by Thy divine instruction, we make bold to say:
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 40

corrections.from: that, assisted by the help of thy mercy, we may always be free from sin and secure from all disturbance.
corrections.to: that, through the bounteous help of Thy mercy, we may always be free from sin and safe from all disquiet.
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 42

corrections.from: be for us who receive it unto life everlasting.
corrections.to: be for us who receive it a source of eternal life.
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 42

corrections.from: regard not my sins, but the faith of Thy Church; and vouchsafe to grant her peace and unity according to Thy will:
corrections.to: look not upon my sins, but upon the faith of Thy Church; and deign to give her peace and unity according to Thy will:
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 42

corrections.from: Praising I will call upon the Lord
corrections.to: I will call upon the Lord and give praise
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 44

corrections.from: and to you Father, that I have sinned
corrections.to: and to you, Father, that I have sinned
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 14 / printed p. 13
corrections.decision: Reviewed against photographed Red Missal and Latin; preserves both Low/Sung original donor texts

corrections.from: whose relics are here, and of all the Saints: that thou wouldst vouchsafe to forgive me all my sins. Amen.
corrections.to: whose relics are here, and of all the Saints, that Thou wilt deign to pardon me all my sins. Amen.
corrections.reference: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei, Latin-English Booklet Missal (2013), PDF p. 16 / printed p. 15
corrections.decision: Reviewed against photographed Red Missal and Latin; preserves both Low/Sung original donor texts

corrections.reference: 2013 Red Missal, printed page 13 (PDF page 14)
corrections.decision: Repair English vocative while retaining the pre-existing Latin accent source correction.

englishEditorialPolicy: 2013 Red Missal preferred English baseline; 1962 printed Latin retains normative authority; reviewed exact-cue adaptations only; preserve immutable donors.
